recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-3705 unless a future work-group decision changes the patient-vs-subject naming policy.
issue_request: FHIR-3705 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core Immunization change request asking to rename Immunization.subject to Immunization.patient because Patient was the only reasonable target.
initial_application: Git commit 64fbbf28ef27948a7944954073c8df878bac2bc9 on 2015-02-13 explicitly included [#3705] Immunization.Subject renamed to Patient and changed the then-source spreadsheet, examples, and search-row surface from subject to patient.
additional_context: Immunization is active in source/fhir.ini. Current source/immunization/structuredefinition-Immunization.xml defines Immunization.patient with cardinality 1..1 and targetProfile Patient. Current source/immunization/bundle-Immunization-search-params.xml defines Immunization-patient and no Immunization-subject. Later Published issue FHIR-7897 supports the patient search-parameter-only pattern. Related FHIR-3706 concerns the same rename guideline for ImmunizationRecommendation but was not needed to decide this seed.
reconciliation: No source change was made because current authoritative source already implements the requested rename and no exact stale Immunization.subject/path/id references were found.

related_jiras.note: Same naming guideline and historical implementation commit for ImmunizationRecommendation.subject to patient, but a separate artifact not decided by this seed audit.
Later PHER Published issue confirmed resources with patient elements should have patient search parameters and not duplicate subject search parameters.
